title: Note: keep the 1-hour cache; 5 minutes only for reviewers

chat.text: We use the 1-hour prompt cache because the Claude program picks it on a subscription. Over 7 days, using 5 minutes everywhere would have cost about 7% more ($2915 vs $2726, API-equivalent). Keep 1 hour for masterminds and your chats. Optional: 5 minutes for reviewers and one-shot helpers saves about $58 a week. The next-steps plan is in public/framework/ai/2026-10-08/cache-ttl-and-plan/proposal.md (pace is about 0.3, so chunk 1 is cleared to start); the reasoning is in recommendation.md beside it. The only thing for you: whether to take the optional 5-minute change at the next Servex restart (I default to yes).
